thread:
Carter: Heads-up — FinLedger is ready to sign a 12-month enterprise commit but we need capacity sizing + preheat/runway + answers to the security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow. They said peak workload ~5k inference requests/min, mix: 70% chat (streaming), 30% embeddings. Can we put together a short risk matrix and presales checklist? cc @Sophia :eyes:

Sophia: Quick traffic breakdown I sketched: average tokens/chat request 450, streaming with on-demand completion; embeddings ~512 tokens, batched at 64. So ops: ~3500 chat rps and ~1500 embedding rps at peak minute. Recommendation: primary model = quantized 13B for chat, fallback = 7B q4 for emergency. Embeddings on 2x smaller p3-equivalent pools. Rough GPU math: 13B q4 ~ 160 rps per A100-equivalent GPU for chat at 450 tokens, so 22 GPUs to hit peak with small buffer. With batching (60ms target batch) and prefix cache expected, we can reduce to ~16 reserved GPUs.

Alan: For autoscale and reserved mix my take: reserve 16 GPUs (committed) + autoscale up to 28 for spikes. Preheat plan: keep 4 warm warm-hot instances ready (preloaded KV cache) during business hours. Canary deploy + hedged requests for tail latency. Suggested autoscale policy below:

Alan: ```json
{
  "min_instances": 4,
  "reserved_instances": 16,
  "max_instances": 28,
  "scale_up_rps_threshold": 400,
  "scale_down_rps_threshold": 250,
  "cooldown_seconds": 120,
  "hedged_requests": true
}
```

Mia: Are we confident about KV prefix caching warmup time? FinLedger said a lot of repeated prefixes from session context. If caching is 1-2s cold, preheat needs to prime caches per AZ. Also SQ: they want CCPA + SOC2 mapping. Who owns the replies? :warning:

Sophia: For KV warmup plan: run a background priming job during preheat that replays top-10k prefixes collected from POC logs. Should spike steady-state tokens served but reduces tail latency. We should also enable request-level caching for embeddings where feasible.

DevOpsBot: Deployment checklist uploaded to Confluence: https://redwood.internal/infra/finledger-preheat-checklist (includes steps: reserve GPUs, bootstrap cache job, canary config, fallback model map, observability dashboards). :white_check_mark:

Priya (Legal): From SQ side — FinLedger flagged data residency and encryption-at-rest + in-transit. For hosted API we need to confirm data retention SLAs and option for VPC/private deployment. If they require HIPAA scope, we need Private + HSM KMS. I'll draft the legal answers but need a cc to security for KMS specifics.

Chris: Pricing note for sales — recommend offering a 12-month reserved plan: commit gets 20% off baseline, plus 10% upfront prepay for burst credits (gives them 24h burst runway). Call out that autoscale beyond reserved will bill at overage hourly rates. Also include an option: mixed commit where embeddings reserved separately (cheaper) — customers like that.

Alan: Fallback/runbook ideas: 1) If p95 latency >= 300ms for 5m -> switch to quantized fallback 7B and enable synchronous batching decrease target to 40ms. 2) If GPU queue > 80% for 3m -> auto-burst to spot-backed nodes (if enabled) and notify oncall. 3) If KV priming job fails -> roll to previous snapshot and throttle new sessions.

Sophia: Fallback matrix (short):
- Normal: 13B q4 (reserved)
- Degraded latency: 7B q4 fallback (reserved + autoscale)
- Capacity exhausted: 7B q4 on spot + reduce streaming chunk size to 256 tokens
- Security-restricted: Private deployment model pinned, no spot allowed

Carter: Love this — can we convert to a one-pager risk matrix + 5-item presales checklist? Action items: 
- [ ] Sophia: finalize GPU count and fallback perf tests (+ run against our perf harness)
- [ ] Alan: add autoscale policy to staging + run failure-mode sim
- [ ] Priya: finish SQ answers and KMS/HSM note
- [ ] DevOps: publish runbook + preheat job playbook
- [ ] Chris: draft pricing options and commit wording for sales agreement

Mia: I'll coordinate with FinLedger product contact about sample prefixes for KV priming. Who's volunteering to run the priming job?

Sophia: I'll run the perf harness tonight and post numbers. Expect a follow-up thread with micro-benchmarks and a small CSV. :thumbsup:

Alan: I'll schedule the autoscale sim tomorrow 09:00 PT and add the canary job. If anyone wants to join ping me.

Carter: Perfect. We'll sync on a brief customer call after we have the one-pager. Thanks all. :rocket:
